On the 15th July, China’s Ministry of Commerce officially implemented restrictions on exports of technologies used in the production of high-density lithium iron phosphate (LFP) and lithium manganese iron phosphate (LMFP) cathode active materials (CAM), effective immediately. It is only the export of technologies to produce materi als that is restricted; the export of cathode materials is not restricted, so overseas battery projects reliant on imports of material from China are unaffected by this announcement. The export restriction could limit ex-China LFP production in future, and therefore offers support for the NCM value chain that supports cobalt demand in the long-term.
